findings.defect: The Korean identifies Ju Hwaran as part of the Escort King’s bloodline; it does not specify that she is his granddaughter.
findings.rationale: 핏줄 establishes descent or blood relation without specifying a generation.
findings.replacement: a descendant of the Escort King

findings.current: I’d woken briefly, then spent three more days asleep.
findings.defect: This makes the three days the duration of the sleep after waking. The source says the period spanning the brief awakening and falling asleep again was three days.
findings.rationale: The source describes the whole period as three days, not three additional days asleep.
findings.replacement: I’d woken briefly, then fallen asleep again. Three days had passed.

findings.current: Once or twice would be bad enough.
findings.defect: The source complains that this has happened more than once or twice; this wording instead says even one or two times would be bad.
findings.rationale: 한두 번도 아니고 means it is not merely once or twice, emphasizing repeated occurrences.
findings.replacement: And it’s not like this has only happened once or twice.

findings.current: You know what? Do your worst!
findings.defect: This drops the source’s crude “cut my belly open” expression, which gives the challenge a specific physical image and bluntness.
findings.rationale: 배 째십시오 is the speaker’s vivid, defiant expression before listing pressure-point strikes and abduction.
findings.replacement: Ah, I don’t care. Cut me open if you want!

findings.defect: The source’s 추왕 repeats the “ugly” image from the preceding joke; “Disgrace” shifts the epithet toward dishonor rather than ugliness.
findings.rationale: The source uses 추왕 after calling the scene 추하다, preserving the same ugly/shameful wordplay in the new title.

summary: Mostly faithful, with a few small shifts in relationship, elapsed time, and comic phrasing.
